data.one_liner: An interactive JSON viewer widget with collapsible and expandable sections.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pretty UI widget to view JSON data hierarchically. Allows users to collapse and expand complex JSON objects and lists at a glance to improve readability.
use_when: You need to display debug or API JSON data inside your Flutter application.
You want users or developers to easily navigate nested JSON structures.
avoid_when: You need a backend data serialization layer or codegen tool.
You are looking for state management or local storage solutions.
strengths: Simple integration as a standard Flutter widget.
Supports collapsible sections for better readability of complex payloads.
weaknesses: Limited to visualization and does not provide advanced editing capabilities out of the box.
